abstract: Nine men with testicular germ cell tumors developed one of two types of histologically similar cystic lesions that had features of choriocarcinoma. In five cases, these choriocarcinoma-like lesions (CCLL) were felt to represent an unusual proliferation of teratomatous epithelium (teratomatous CCLL); whereas in four cases, the CCLL was felt to represent a nonbiphasic and cystic form of choriocarcinoma similar to the atypical choriocarcinoma described by Mazur et al. except for its cystic nature. Both types usually occurred as focal findings associated with teratomas. Eight of nine patients had received chemotherapy prior to excision of the CCLL. Teratomatous CCLLs often had a lacelike arrangement of atypical epithelium around cysts that contained homogeneous secretion. Mucicarmine stains were positive in four of five cases of teratomatous CCLLs. Cystic atypical choriocarcinoma consisted of stratified mononucleated cells lining cysts containing a coagulum of eosinophilic material. Stains for human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) were positive in three of four cases of cystic atypical choriocarcinoma, although serum HCG elevations were either negative or just slightly elevated preoperatively. Five patients with a CCLL who were clinically free of disease following surgical excision and who received no additional chemotherapy remained well on follow-up (average, 1.9 years). We encourage the separate recognition of these lesions so that future studies may determine their clinical significance more precisely.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性9例に、絨毛癌の特徴を備えた組織学的に類似した嚢胞性病変の2つのタイプが発生した。5例では、この絨毛癌様病変（CCLL）は奇形腫上皮の異常な増殖と考えられ（奇形腫性CCLL）、4例では、Mazurらが記載した非典型絨毛癌に類似するが嚢胞性である、嚢胞性非典型絨毛癌と考えられた。いずれのタイプも通常、奇形腫に伴う限局性の所見として認められた。9例中8例は、CCLL切除前に化学療法を受けていた。奇形腫性CCLLでは、嚢胞の周囲に異型上皮がレース状に配列し、均質な分泌物を含む像が多く見られた。奇形腫性CCLL 5例中4例でムチカルミン染色が陽性であった。嚢胞性非典型絨毛癌4例中3例で、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)染色が陽性であったが、術前の血清hCG上昇は陰性かわずかな上昇にとどまった。外科的切除後に臨床的に病変がなく、追加の化学療法を受けなかったCCLL 5例は、平均1.9年のフォローアップ中も良好な経過をたどった。将来の研究でこれらの病変の臨床的意義をより正確に決定できるよう、これらの病変を個別に認識することを提唱する。
